preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of segments is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The attractiveness of each shop is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimal possible velocity at the beginning must be at least 1.
The minimal possible velocity at the beginning must not exceed the maximum attractiveness of any shop.

postconditions.expression: all(output_velocity >= W for W in (W1, W2, ..., WN))
postconditions.description: The minimal possible velocity at the beginning must be greater than or equal to the attractiveness of any shop.

postconditions.expression: all(output_velocity >= output_velocity - i for i in range(1, N))
postconditions.description: The velocity must decrease by at least 1 after each segment.
